About · Legal

Important — Please read before using FoCo After Dark in Fort Collins, CO

About FoCo After Dark

FoCo After Dark is a Fort Collins-based nightlife membership app created by the FoCo After Dark team. The platform is designed to make local nights out easier and more rewarding by connecting members with participating venues through real-time perks, secure pass verification, and streamlined redemption tools.

Our goal is simple: support local nightlife, improve guest experience, and give venues practical tools that keep lines moving and service efficient. We build with a privacy-first mindset and continue improving the app through live feedback from members, venue staff, and local partners.

Age requirement

You must be 21 years of age or older to redeem alcoholic beverage vouchers in Fort Collins, Colorado. FoCo After Dark enforces 21+ account eligibility during signup. Venues may still require a valid government-issued photo ID at redemption.

Responsible service

Vouchers are subject to venue policies and Colorado law. Do not serve alcohol to persons who are visibly intoxicated. Venue staff retain the right to refuse service in accordance with state and local regulations.

Voucher terms

  • Vouchers are one-time use unless otherwise stated.
  • Vouchers have no cash value and are non-transferable where prohibited.
  • Vouchers may require venue confirmation and proof of age at redemption.
  • FoCo After Dark and participating venues reserve the right to revoke or invalidate vouchers for fraud or misuse.

Local availability

FoCo After Dark is designed for use in Fort Collins, CO and participating venues in the area. Offers, perks, and redemption availability vary by venue and may change without notice.

Service availability & realtime updates

FoCo After Dark relies on internet connectivity, device capability, and third-party services (including Firebase and payment processors). While we design for near real-time sync, delivery can be delayed by network conditions, device power settings, or platform constraints. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service or zero-latency delivery.

Maintenance windows & downtime

FoCo After Dark may enter scheduled or emergency maintenance to protect platform stability, security, and data integrity. During these windows, some or all app features may be temporarily unavailable. Membership fees are billed for access to the service over the billing period as a whole, and short maintenance interruptions do not automatically create credits, refunds, or prorated adjustments except where required by law.

Beta features & changes

During beta, features, pricing, perks, and availability may change without notice. Some data or features may reset or be removed when the product launches live.

Billing & cancellations

Memberships are available on monthly and yearly billing schedules. Yearly plans are billed upfront. Failed charges may be retried. You may cancel at any time and access remains active until the end of the paid billing period. Yearly plans are non-refundable once billed except where required by law. Payment processing is handled by Stripe or other third-party processors; FoCo After Dark does not store full card numbers.

Venue responsibility

Venues control their own perks, redemption policies, and service decisions. Venue staff may refuse service, decline a redemption, or modify offers in accordance with local laws and venue policies.

Account security

You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and device access. If you believe your account has been accessed without permission, contact support immediately.

Data accuracy & audit logs

We log redemption attempts, verification events, and timestamps for operational, analytics, and fraud-prevention purposes. We strive for accuracy, but logs may be delayed or incomplete due to connectivity or device issues.

App behavior (PWA)

When installed to a home screen, the app may cache assets for performance. Updates are delivered when the app reconnects and reloads. If the app is locked by administrators, access is restricted until unlocked by the CEO.

Waitlist & launch communications

If waitlist mode is active, app actions are temporarily disabled until launch access is restored. Waitlist submissions are used only for launch announcements, product updates, and account availability notices.

Liability & safety

FoCo After Dark is not responsible for injuries, property damage, or other consequences from alcohol consumption. Use vouchers responsibly. If you or someone appears intoxicated, seek assistance, use a rideshare service, and never let them drive.

Privacy Notice (In-App)

This Privacy Notice explains what information FoCo After Dark (operated by FoCo After Dark) collects, how we use it, and your choices. This in-app notice is intended to provide full disclosure of our practices (excluding internal secrets such as encryption keys or internal operational credentials).

Information we collect
  • Account data: name, email, birthdate used for 21+ eligibility checks, and profile details you provide.
  • Age eligibility data: 21+ eligibility status derived from your provided account information. We do not collect or store full government ID images in app storage.
  • Authentication & identifiers: Firebase UID, device identifiers, and Pass ID for your membership.
  • Redemption & audit logs: voucher codes generated, redemption attempts, timestamps, venue identifiers, and staff verification events to support operations and fraud prevention.
  • Payment info: we use third-party processors for payments and do not store full card numbers in-app; only masked card references or tokens may be kept for billing convenience.
  • Support communications: messages you send to support, including optional contact details.
  • Usage & analytics: device & browser info, interaction events, crash reports, and performance metrics to improve the product.
How we use information

We use information to operate and improve the service: to authenticate members, enable and verify voucher redemptions, prevent abuse and fraud, provide support, process payments, and analyze usage for product improvements. We may also use aggregated, de-identified data for analytics and partner reporting.

AI features

Some in-app features may use AI to generate responses or summaries (for example, HQ assistant tools). AI output may be inaccurate or incomplete. Do not rely on AI responses for legal, medical, or safety decisions. We may use prompts and system data to improve reliability, but we do not train public AI models on your private data without permission.

Sharing & third parties

We share data only as needed to provide the service: with payment processors, hosting and database providers (e.g., Firebase), analytics providers, and venues for redemption verification. We do not sell personal data. Any third party we use is contractually required to protect personal data and limit use to providing the requested services.

Data retention & your rights

We retain redemption and audit logs for operational and fraud-prevention purposes for a reasonable period (typically up to 3 years) unless otherwise required by law. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting support. Deleting your account will remove your personal profile; some anonymized or aggregated logs may be retained for legal or operational reasons.

Refunds, disputes & chargebacks

Subscription fees are billed according to your membership plan. Refunds are not guaranteed and are evaluated case-by-case. If you believe a charge is incorrect, contact support first so we can review and resolve it before you file a dispute with your card issuer.

Venue liability & third-party services

Participating venues are independent businesses. They control their own pricing, promotions, and service decisions. FoCo After Dark is not responsible for venue policies, service outcomes, or changes to offers. Third-party services (payments, hosting, messaging) operate under their own terms and policies.

Security

We use industry-standard measures such as TLS for data in transit and rely on hosting providers' encryption-at-rest. Access to production systems is restricted and logged. We do not publish internal credentials or secrets in-app.

Children

This service is intended for adults 21+. We do not knowingly collect information from children under the legal drinking age.

Contact

For privacy requests or questions, email focoafterdark@gmail.com or use the in-app support form. For legal inquiries, contact the FoCo After Dark team through the same address.
